utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, can everyone hear me? Diego, I think you're on mute.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Sorry. Yeah, uh, better now.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Good. So, um, the contractor thing. We've been circling it since, what, January?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: February, but yeah-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: February. Right. Anyway, where are we on it?

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: On what, the access list or the devices?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Devices. Access list is, I mean, Tomasz has that.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Oh, Tomasz sent a new version Friday? Or Thursday. He added a column for the agency name, which honestly I'd been asking for since-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Chloe, sorry, can we stay on devices?

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Yeah, yeah, go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: So the big picture is contractors get into prod from, you know, whatever they've got at home. Which isn't great.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Define whatever. Some are on agency machines, no?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: A few, I think.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Okay so what if we just buy laptops. Ours, managed, for all thirty-eight who have prod data access.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: All thirty-eight? Not the staging-only people?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Staging-only isn't in the thirty-eight. That's the prod list.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Okay. Just checking.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: That's, like, a lot of laptops though.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: It is, but the audit last quarter - remember? Twelve of them were reaching prod from their own machines. No disk encryption on any of them.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Was that the one with the auditor's follow-up call?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: That one, yes. Follow-up's still open, actually.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: And a managed one runs about eleven-fifty each, so that's what it takes to close that.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Devil's advocate. That's forty-something thousand, for people who leave in six months.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Not all of them leave in six months.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Some do. Rania's two went in January.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Those were, um, the data migration pair. Short contract.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Right, so that's exactly my point.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Laptops come back though. You wipe them, reissue-

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: If they come back.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: That's what the return form is for.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: We had that with the loaner batch two years ago, half of them took ages to come back. Someone's sister had one for like a year. Anyway.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Chloe, focus.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Sorry. Anyway, the form helps.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Who ships them? Who images them?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: We do. It's maybe, uh, two hours each with the profile.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Two hours times thirty-eight. Sione's already underwater with onboarding.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Sione's fine, we'll work it out. That's details.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Imaging can be batched, it's not two hours of hands-on.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Yeah, most of it's waiting.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Okay, fair.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Can I ask something totally different? Did anyone see the thing about the train strike next week? I'm supposed to be in Rotterdam Tuesday for Daan's workshop and-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Chloe-

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: -and apparently the whole line's out, so I'm looking at buses, which is four hours, and I get motion sick, which I never told anyone.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Is Daan's thing mandatory?

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: He says optional. He says everything is optional.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Then dial in. Okay, back.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Yeah, sorry. Back.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: So the laptops. What do the contractors say? Has anyone asked them?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Alejandra said a couple were okay with it, I think. Not everyone.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: A couple.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It's a security thing. They don't get much of a vote, really.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Most already carry two machines anyway.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Some do. The agency ones.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: And the unmanaged ones, where do they stand after? We just cut them off?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I mean, once they have a laptop it's moot, no?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Right, the laptop becomes the access path. That's-

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: I'm just saying there'll be a gap while they're being issued.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: A few weeks, sure.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Few weeks. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Budget though. Where does it come from, ours or each project's?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Finance has a line for it. Probably. I'll check with them.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Probably.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Well, there's a hardware line. I'll confirm.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Last year the hardware line had room, because we didn't replace the-

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: The conference-room screens, yes.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Right.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: The screens got pushed to Q3, I think.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, noted.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Can I push on the audit number once more? Twelve of thirty-eight is a third, give or take. The rest are already on something.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: The rest are on something of ours or something we can see. The twelve we couldn't verify.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Couldn't or didn't?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Couldn't. Auditor flagged it, no way to check the disk.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Hm. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Side note, did the ticket queue thing get fixed? Milan said escalations were landing in the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Yeah, I changed the routing Monday.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Great. Thanks, Diego.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: He did mention that, and also the headset thing. Milan's headset died again.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Order him one. Small thing.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: I'll put it on my list. Which is long.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Back to this. Where do we land? Because Tomasz wants an answer for the next contractor onboarding batch.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Tomasz wants a lot of things.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: He wants this one by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Um. Hang on, let me think about it.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: One more worry. If we do this for the prod people, the staging folks will ask.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: They'll ask. That's a different conversation.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Yeah, that's a whole other list.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Uh, one question. Do the laptops get the same image as ours?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Same base, trimmed. Without the internal wiki stuff.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay. That works.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. So, big picture, our own managed laptops go to every contractor who's in prod. Zainab, you and Diego put the order together and run the numbers past finance.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Yep, I'll draft the request tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Fine by me. I'll stop playing devil's advocate.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: You never stop.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: True.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, last bit, Daan covers the on-call swap next week while Chloe's on a bus.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: I'll be on a bus, dialed in.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Right. Who has the notes?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: I can take them.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Thanks. Zainab, send me the audit page for finance.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: It's page four. Or five. I'll send the whole thing.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Perfect. Anything else?

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Is anyone going to Sione's thing Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: What thing?

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: The, um, welcome lunch. Place on the corner.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: I'll come if it's noon.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Noon works.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I have a hard stop, I'm sorry. I have to jump to another call.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, let's start. Sorry, I was stuck on a call with finance until just now.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Did they say anything about the hardware line?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Sort of. I'll get to it. Diego, you had the vendor thing, right?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Yeah. Um, heard back Friday. And from two of the agencies yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, good, go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: So the vendor says seven weeks, door to door, for all thirty-eight. And the two agencies, uh, they said if contractors have to carry a second laptop for an engagement, they'd sooner pull those people off it.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Seven weeks? They said three, maybe four, when I called in February.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: That was a smaller number, I think. Thirty-eight is a bigger lot for them.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Which two agencies?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: The one Alejandra works with, and the data one. I can forward the emails.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Yeah, forward them to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Okay but hold on. Seven weeks is basically two months where every one of those people is still getting into prod from whatever they own, so the exposure just sits there. And we'd be paying forty-three seven, roughly, for a group where half of them are gone by the next half-year anyway. That's a lot of money for something I can't make add up.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: They're not gone, we wipe them and reissue-

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: If they come back, which Kwame already said last week, and he was right-

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: I did say that, thank you.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Okay, but the alternative is nothing. The audit follow-up is still open.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Right, the audit. Big picture, we do need something.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Something. Not necessarily this.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Then what-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Hold on. Let's not solve it right now. Diego, can you get the vendor to put the seven weeks in writing?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Yeah. They only said it on the phone, I think. Maybe the portal has it.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Please.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Can we ask if they'd split it? Ship twenty first, then the rest later?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: I can ask. I don't know.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Oh, that reminds me of the monitors, when we ordered in two lots and one lot came in the wrong size, or the wrong color, I forget, anyway Rania had to-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Chloe.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Sorry, sorry. Sizes. It's fine.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: So for now what? We just wait on the vendor?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: For now, yes. I mean, let's park it, we have other stuff.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Parked with no date.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: There's a date, it's a range-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, okay. Patch window. Is Sunday still fine for everybody?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Sunday night is fine for me. I'm on call anyway.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: I'm out until Monday noon, so, um, not me.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Fine, Zainab and Kwame then.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: I have a thing Sunday afternoon but night's okay.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Great.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Is the cert for the VPN gateway done too? Because that expires on the-

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: The thirtieth? No, I renewed it, I think. Or I started it. There's a ticket.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Started or renewed?

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Renewal requested. Waiting on Milan to approve.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: That's not renewed.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: It's in progress! It's practically the same thing.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Can someone chase Milan?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: I'll message him.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Thanks, Diego.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: While we're on stuff that quietly expires, the shared password vault. Who's been looking at that?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: What about it?

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Nobody reviews who's in it. Or when they do, it's whenever.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Tomasz did one last year, I think? Autumn.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: It was before the reorg, because I remember Alejandra was still on the list and she'd moved by then, and she was actually the one who told me about the-

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: What if we went through the vault's access list every quarter. Just on a schedule.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Why every quarter, why not once a year?

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Because when we went through it last, there were nine accounts nobody could explain. Three of those were people who'd already left.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Three who left and still had logins?

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Okay, that's bad.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Was that the one where we diffed against the HR list?

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: That one.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: How long does it take, though? Is it a whole day?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Half a day. Mostly the diff.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. Quarterly review of the shared password vault, then. Kwame, you own it, first one in June.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Sure. I'll put it in the calendar.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Make it recurring so nobody forgets.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Yes, recurring.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Right. Finance. The hardware line.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Finally.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: They said there's room, I think. Not sure how much room.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: For forty-odd thousand?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Um. I'd have to ask again. The person who knows is out.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: So we don't know if the money exists and we don't know when the laptops exist.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: We know some things.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Name one.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: The audit follow-up is open. That's one.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: That's a good one, though.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Does the quote hold, though? Or does it move if we wait a few weeks to decide?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: It's good for thirty days, it says.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: So end of April.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: About. Middle, maybe.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Which is when the seven weeks would already be running.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Only if we order.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Right, only if.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: I'll put the date in the email.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Good. When can you do that?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Tomorrow. Maybe Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Tomorrow's better.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay, tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Does anyone know if Sione's onboarding batch is still the first week of April?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: That's what Tomasz said last week.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: That's the batch that's waiting on all this, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Partly. I mean, they can start with their own machines.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: For now.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: For now, yeah. Hm.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Which is what Chloe keeps bringing up.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: I'm not complaining, I'm pointing at the exposure.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Exposure we have today, with the twelve.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Exactly, so it's not the seven weeks, it's that nothing is different until then.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: That's the gap, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Like what, an interim thing?

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: I don't know. I'm just saying the gap is the gap.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, I really can't settle this today.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Should I still send the emails?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Yes, please, today.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Who's taking notes?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Diego did last time.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: I'll do it.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Thanks, Kwame. And Daan's still covering Chloe's on-call?

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Only last week. This week it's me.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Right, right. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: It's fine.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: One last thing, are we still on for lunch with Sione?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I have to jump, I'm sorry. Send me the details.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, um, can everyone hear me? Diego, you're unmuted, good.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Yeah. Learned my lesson.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Who's got notes? I did them last time, so-

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: I'll do them. Well, I'll try. I'm bad at typing and listening at the same time.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Thanks. So, uh, before the patch window business, I want to pull the contractor laptops back up. Last week it was the seven weeks and the price sitting there, and I don't love that we just left it hanging.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Good, because I've been holding something since Friday.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Hang on. Are we actually reconsidering, or are we just talking ourselves back into the same answer?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I mean, looking at it again. That's all. Chloe, you had the money side, right?

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Yeah, so, forty-three seven or thereabouts for the buy, then seven weeks where nothing's different, and half those people rotate out by autumn. That's what bugs me.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Can I- sorry. Diego, did the vendor put the lead time in writing?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Yeah, it came through the portal. Seven weeks. They said they'd ship a first batch sooner if we split it, but, um, not by much.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: So the gap is real.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: It's the gap, and also owning machines for people on six-month stints. I just can't make that sit right.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Okay, that's what I wanted to get to. The vendor also does a rental thing, it's about thirty-eight dollars a unit a month, six-month terms. Which is basically how long most of these engagements run.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: And for the gap, we switch off prod access from anything unmanaged starting in week two. Alejandra's agency and the data one both wrote back that they're fine with that.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Thirty-eight a month. So, what, fourteen hundred a month for the lot?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Closer to fourteen-fifty. Call it nine thousand for the six months, if nobody extends.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Against forty-three seven. Okay, that's a different conversation.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Unless they extend. Then you're renting forever.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Sure, but when someone leaves it goes back in the box. No wiping, no reissuing, no chasing the return form.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Still managed by us though? Same image?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Same trimmed image, our profile. The vendor just owns the hardware.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay. Then imaging's the same job.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Why week two? Why not week one?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Week one they're getting set up, you have to let them in somewhere. Week two the block goes on.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: And the agencies are really okay with that? Last week they were threatening to pull people.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: That was about carrying a second laptop. This is the reverse, they carry ours and nothing else.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Which two was that again? Alejandra's and the data one?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Yes. Diego has the emails.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Yeah, both replied Monday. I'll forward them again.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: What about the twelve with no disk encryption? They'd be covered once the block is on?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Anyone reaching prod would be on a managed disk, so yes. That's what I'd send the auditor.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Not before week two, though.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: No. After the block's actually in.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Fine. I'm running out of objections, which is annoying.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Diego, anything from you?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Um. Just, the rentals have a return date, right? Somebody has to track it.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: It's renewable at six months. I'll add a column to the order sheet.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Does finance mind that it's monthly instead of one purchase?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I'd have to ask them. Hardware line, other line, I never remember which is which.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: I'm fairly sure rental is the operating side. That's honestly easier.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Good. Okay, so, the company-managed laptops for the contractors in prod, all thirty-eight, that's where we are. Zainab, you keep the order moving.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Yep, I'll update the draft today.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Do I get to stop now?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: You never stop.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Ha. True.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Patch window. Still Sunday night?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Sunday night is fine, I'm on call anyway.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Me too, evening's okay. I've got a thing in the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: I'm out until Monday noon, so, not me.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Right, Zainab and Kwame. Chloe, the VPN gateway cert, where's that?

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Waiting on Milan. I pinged him twice.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: It expires on the thirtieth.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: I know, I know. I'll go stand at his desk.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: He's remote.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Then I'll stand at his screen.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: I can message him too if you want.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Yes please, double pressure.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. Sione's lunch, did anyone sort a time?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Thursday, noon, I think.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Is Tomasz coming?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: He said maybe. He says maybe to everything.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Tomasz said something about the onboarding batch too. Does anyone remember the date?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: First week of April, last I heard.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: That's this week. Okay. Okay, noted.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Are the notes going to the usual list?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Yes, please. And add the vendor emails.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Will do. Zainab, which page of the audit do you want attached?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Page four. Or five. I'll just send you the whole thing.

utterances.speaker: Chloe
utterances.text: Great, that's what I expected.

utterances.speaker: Kwame
utterances.text: Anything else? I have a call at the top of the hour.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Nope, I think that's it. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Thanks.
